# Vendor Info: Marked

- **Project**: [Ultra-fast markdown parser and compiler](https://github.com/markedjs/marked)
- **Version**: 18.1.1
- **License**: MIT
- **Distribution**: [jsDelivr npm registry](https://www.jsdelivr.com/package/npm/marked)

**How to update**
1. Open the central `updater.html` tool in your browser.
2. Click "Choose parent folder" and select the root directory (e.g. `vendor/`).
3. Select **Marked** from the dropdown menu.
4. Click "Download Target Version". The tool will automatically target the `vendor/marked/` subfolder, create it if needed, and write the updated files.
5. Update [sw.js](../../sw.js), [THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md](../../THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md) and [README.md](../../README.md) with generated related snippets.

**Files maintained by the updater**
* `marked.umd.min.js`
